item.title: ‘Nothing To See Here’: Dem Squad Member Doesn’t Want To Discuss Her $8 Million Wealth Jump Since Entering Congress
item.description: Democratic Massachusetts Rep. Ayanna Pressley brushed off a question Wednesday about how her wealth jumped to as much as $8 million after initially entering Congress with a negative net worth.

item.title: Detransitioner’s Victory Could Deal Death Blow To Trans Medical Industry
item.description: Removing adolescents' healthy body parts under the guise of treating gender dysphoria could soon become a "thing of the past" as doctors reckon with the reality of financial penalties.

item.title: Ex-Democrat Strategist Explains Why Potential 2028 Rivals In Party Not ‘Attacking’ Harris
item.description: Former Democratic strategist Dan Turrentine said on Friday that possible 2028 presidential contenders in former Vice President Kamala Harris' party were refraining from criticizing her because they believe her failure is inevitable.

item.title: NYT Reader Faces Moral Quandary As Immigrant Neighbors Start Thriving Auto Body Shop In Driveway
